facts.text: AIU uses intellipath, a proprietary adaptive learning tool that assesses students' existing knowledge to customize coursework around topics they still need to learn.

sources.title: Intellipath Adaptive Learning Platform | AIU
sources.quote: AIU's intellipath® is an online learning tool that helps you build a curriculum for your classes based on what you already know. Using a series of questions related to the course, intellipath® customizes your coursework

facts.text: The AIU Advantage Grant provides between $500 and $1,000 per program for students facing extreme personal or financial hardships.

sources.title: College Scholarships and Grants | AIU
sources.quote: AIU Advantage Grant $500 - $1,000 per academic program for students who face extreme personal and/or financial hardships.
